lines.text: She texts me every five minutes!

data.define: Describes someone who wants too much attention.

misuse.text: Don't call a friend 'clingy' to her face.

hook.text: She texts me every five minutes!

publish.title: What does "clingy" mean?
publish.value: Clingy = Too needy and always near. Example: "My puppy is so clingy." (casual English).
